question: Should Neuralwatt expose both prepaid USD credits and active subscription kWh allowance, or intentionally define the provider as balance-only?
rationale: The API returns two independent usable quota pools, and code review cannot determine whether omitting subscription capacity is an acceptable permanent product contract.

options.title: Show both quota pools
options.body: Render prepaid credits and active subscription kWh allowance as separate, clearly labeled metrics so usable capacity is not hidden.

options.title: Accept balance-only semantics
options.body: Keep the current UI only with explicit maintainer acceptance and clear documentation that subscription capacity is omitted.

recommendation.title: Show both quota pools
recommendation.body: Render prepaid credits and active subscription kWh allowance as separate, clearly labeled metrics so usable capacity is not hidden.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the Neuralwatt hardening commits and the related branch’s product-contract analysis.
